description: Buddy Phase 3 — True Model Intelligence. Adds real A/B model inference, per-pair model switching, scheduled self-retraining, and session-persistent RL memory. Builds on Phase 2's 10-module automation pipeline.

userStories.title: True candidate model inference for A/B shadow testing
userStories.description: As a learning system, ModelManager shadow tests must compare REAL predictions from both incumbent and candidate models, not just re-score the incumbent.
acceptanceCriteria: ModelManager loads candidate .keras model separately (lazy, on first shadow test)
During each scan, both incumbent AND candidate run inference on the same features
Shadow results log both predictions + actual outcome to shadow_predictions.jsonl
Candidate model loading wrapped in try/except — if candidate fails, fall back to incumbent-only mode
Memory-safe: candidate model unloaded if shadow testing is paused/disabled
Config toggle: enable_true_ab_testing: bool in ScannerConfig (default False, enable in smart profile)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-19. CandidateModelLoader added to model_manager.py. Lazy loads buddy_tf_candidate.keras. enable_true_ab_testing config toggle. Falls back to incumbent-only on failure.

userStories.title: Per-pair model selection with automatic switching
userStories.description: As a trading system, each pair should use whichever model version (joint or per-pair fine-tuned) has better accuracy for that specific pair.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/pair_model_selector.py with PairModelSelector class
Maintains accuracy registry: { pair: { joint_accuracy, per_pair_accuracy, active_model, sample_size } }
For each pair, track prediction accuracy of both joint and per-pair model over rolling 30 trades
If per-pair accuracy > joint accuracy by 2%+ on 30+ trades, switch that pair to per-pair model
If per-pair model degrades below joint, auto-switch back
Selector integrated into Scanner: before inference, select model for current pair
Model selection logged to trained_data/models/pair_model_selections.jsonl
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-19. pair_model_selector.py with PairModelSelector class. Rolling EMA accuracy tracking. execute_switch() auto-switches + logs to pair_model_selections.jsonl. Wired into continuous.py step 5j.

userStories.title: Scheduled self-retraining trigger based on drift detection
userStories.description: As a self-improving system, I should automatically trigger retraining when model accuracy drifts below acceptable thresholds.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/retrain_trigger.py with RetrainTrigger class
Monitor rolling 50-trade accuracy per pair. If < 52% (barely above random), flag for retrain
Monitor rolling 50-trade accuracy across all pairs. If < 53%, flag full retrain
When retrain triggered: write retrain_request.json with { pairs_to_retrain, reason, accuracy_snapshot }
scheduled_retrain.py checks for retrain_request.json on each run and prioritizes flagged pairs
Cooldown: don't re-trigger retrain within 24 hours of last retrain
Log trigger decisions to observations.jsonl with category 'retrain_trigger'
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-19. retrain_trigger.py with RetrainTrigger class. Wired into continuous.py step 5i. Writes retrain_request.json. 24h cooldown.

userStories.title: Multi-session RL weight persistence with decay and recovery
userStories.description: As a learning system, RL agent weights should persist meaningfully across sessions with proper decay to prevent overfitting to old data.
acceptanceCriteria: agent_weights.json stores per-regime weights + metadata: { regime: { agent: weight, _meta: { last_trade_id, trade_count, last_updated } } }
On session start: load weights, apply time-based decay (weights drift 1% toward baseline per 24h since last update)
On session end: save weights with metadata update
Weight confidence: new weights (< 10 trades) blended 70/30 with baseline, mature weights (> 50 trades) used at full strength
Recovery: if agent_weights.json is corrupted, reset to baseline with log entry
Weight snapshots saved to trained_data/models/weight_snapshots/ every 50 trades for rollback
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-19. agents.py has _apply_time_decay(), apply_weight_decay(), _save_weight_snapshot(), load_weight_snapshot(). weight_snapshots/50.json confirmed created. Confidence blending present.

userStories.title: News risk agent integration with economic calendar
userStories.description: As a trading system, I need to be aware of high-impact economic events and adjust confidence or skip trading during volatile news windows.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/agents/news_calendar.py with NewsCalendarAgent class
Fetch weekly economic calendar from free API (forexfactory or similar, or use static JSON)
Classify events: HIGH impact (NFP, FOMC, ECB), MEDIUM (CPI, PMI), LOW (minor)
During scan: if HIGH impact event within 30 minutes for a pair's currency, apply -20% confidence penalty
During scan: if HIGH impact event within 2 hours, apply -10% confidence penalty
Post-event: no penalty after event passes (don't miss post-news momentum trades)
Cache calendar locally (refresh daily), never block scan on API failure
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-19. src/scanner/agents/news_calendar.py. EconomicEvent classification (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW). Time-based penalties: HIGH -20%/<30min, -10%/<2h. Daily cache. Seed events fallback. Wired into _evaluate_news_risk in agents.py replacing stub.

userStories.title: Comprehensive pre-deployment validation suite
userStories.description: As an operator, I need a single command that validates the entire system is ready for live trading before starting watch mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/validate_deployment.py that checks ALL of: (1) All 10+ automation modules import, (2) OANDA API connectivity (practice account), (3) Model files exist and load, (4) agent_weights.json valid, (5) pair_accuracy.json valid (not contaminated), (6) .claude/state.json valid, (7) trade_journal_rl.json valid or doesn't exist, (8) Config profiles all valid, (9) blocked_pairs list correct, (10) Environment variables present
Output: GREEN (all pass), YELLOW (warnings but can proceed), RED (must fix before trading)
Each check reports: status, details, fix suggestion if failed
Can run via: python scripts/validate_deployment.py
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-19. scripts/validate_deployment.py — 49 checks across 11 categories. GREEN/YELLOW/RED exit codes.
